svg.aria-label: TemirTech (developed, private source): Learning project · TR / EN. A bilingual website I built to learn WebGL 3D and CI/CD, with performance budgets that fail the build. Build fails if Lighthouse budgets regress. Hardened contact form: validation, rate limit, CAPTCHA. Security headers, error reports with PII off. Stack: Next.js, Three.js, Playwright.
